about.subtitle: A unique accommodation experience in the city center, at the heart of transportation.
about.description: Located just a 3-minute walk from Marmaray, our hotel serves with a 'Room Only' concept. Has Termal Otel is the ideal starting point for your business and leisure trips with its central location, modern and hygienic rooms, and easy access to both sides.

about_section.heading: We are dedicated to creating moments of peace & comfort for every guest
about_section.description: As Has Termal Otel, we blend the warmth of home with affordable and modern details in the center of Maltepe. With our proximity to Marmaray and high-level comfort, we promise the most ambitious value-for-money experience in the region.
